fluidcompat.configuration.title: Fluid Compat Configs
fluidcompat.configuration.fluids.tooltip: Which fluids are drained from the world
jei.fluidcompat.finite_pump: With Fluid Compat this pump no longer creates water. Every bit it pumps is removed from the water source blocks around it, so a small pond can run dry. Place it next to a large body of water such as an ocean or river and let the water flow back in.
fluidcompat.tab.mod_compat_list.tooltip: Every mod Fluid Compat works with. Turn modules off or lower their cost if your game lags.
fluidcompat.group.overview.desc: Status of every compatibility module in this game.
fluidcompat.group.mi.desc: Bronze, Steel and Electric Water Pump. These two values were already in fluidcompat-common.toml and keep working as before.
fluidcompat.group.mekanism.desc: Makes the Electric Pump really remove the source blocks it pumps.
fluidcompat.group.mekanism_diesel_genera: Mekanism Diesel Generators (Shaft Pump, Inline Pump)
Makes the Create-powered Shaft Pump and Inline Pump take water out of the world instead of making it. Needs Create. Switches itself off if a new Mekanism Diesel Generators changes how the pumps work.
fluidcompat.option.mdgPumpsEnabled.desc: The world pays for exactly the water these pumps receive, every tick they pump. Only applies while water is finite, see fluidcompat-common.toml.
fluidcompat.group.enderio.desc: Lets the Drain empty a pond completely, keeps the Niard from losing water when it fills a thin layer, and treats the conduit bundle as a submerged pipe. Each hook switches itself off if a new Ender IO changes the code it relies on.
fluidcompat.option.enderioEnabled.desc: Master switch for the Drain and Niard hooks.
fluidcompat.option.enderioConduitsAsPipe: Flowing Fluids lets the conduit bundle stay submerged instead of draining or displacing the water around it. Needs a game restart.
fluidcompat.option.enderioDrainThin.desc: The Drain also takes the thin, non-source water layers Flowing Fluids leaves behind and keeps running when the block under it is one. Each layer is taken as exactly the water it holds, paid by the world.
fluidcompat.option.enderioNiardRefund: Niard Pays Only What The World Gains
fluidcompat.option.enderioNiardRefund.de: When the Niard turns a thin layer of its own fluid into a full source block, it is only charged for the part the layer did not already hold, so no water is lost.
fluidcompat.group.immersiveengineering.d: Stops the Fluid Pump from making endless water out of pools with two source blocks, lets it empty a pond completely and keeps it from leaving cobblestone. Switches itself off if a new Immersive Engineering changes how the pump works.
fluidcompat.option.iePumpFinite.desc: The Fluid Pump removes source blocks (1000 mB each) instead of filling its tank from nothing. Only for fluids Fluid Compat treats as finite.
fluidcompat.option.iePumpNoCobble.desc: Skip the cobblestone the pump puts where it emptied a block, when the fluid is finite. IE warns this can cause lag when pumping large amounts.
fluidcompat.option.iePumpDrainThin.desc: The pump also takes the thin layers of fluid left behind, so a pond can be emptied completely. Each layer is paid by the world.
fluidcompat.group.alexscaves.desc: Makes the Drain move finite fluid level by level. The Copper Valve only sends the redstone signal and needs no hook.
fluidcompat.option.alexsDrainEnabled.des: Make the Drain take fluid from above and put the same amount below, using Flowing Fluids levels.
fluidcompat.option.alexsDrainMaxLevels.d: Most fluid one Drain moves per cycle, in 1/8 bucket levels. 512 = 64 blocks (original limit).
fluidcompat.option.alexsDrainInterval.de: Ticks between two cycles of an open Drain. 20 = original speed. Higher = less work.
fluidcompat.option.alexsDrainSpread.desc: How far sideways the released fluid may spread below the Drain.
fluidcompat.option.alexsDrainEffects.des: Play Alex's Caves' own drain sound and bubbles.
fluidcompat.group.mekanism_elements.desc: Makes the Seawater Pump drain the water source below it.
fluidcompat.group.fluidlogged.desc: Lets fluids enter pipes through Fluidlogged. OFF by default because it was seen to duplicate water with Flowing Fluids. Changes need a game restart.
fluidcompat.option.enableFiniteFluids.de: Master switch of the core rules. Off = every machine behaves as without Fluid Compat.
fluidcompat.option.backendPreference.des: Which system removes fluid from the world. AUTO prefers Flowing Fluids when it is installed.
fluidcompat.option.finiteWater.desc: Pumps drain water from the world instead of creating it.
fluidcompat.option.finiteLava.desc: Pumps drain lava from the world instead of creating it.
fluidcompat.option.finiteTaggedFluids.de: Also treat fluids in the tag fluidcompat:managed_fluids as finite.
fluidcompat.option.compatEnabled.desc: Master switch for every compat module. Turn it off if you suspect one of them causes lag.
fluidcompat.option.miDrainPercent.desc: World water consumed per unit pumped. 100 = one for one, 50 = twice as efficient.
fluidcompat.option.miMinTicks.desc: Minimum ticks between two drains of the same pump. Higher = slower pumps and less work. 0 = no limit.
fluidcompat.option.electricPumpEnabled.d: Force the Electric Pump to remove source blocks.
fluidcompat.option.electricPumpWater.des: Apply to water (needs Finite Water in Core).
fluidcompat.option.electricPumpLava.desc: Apply to lava (needs Finite Lava in Core).
fluidcompat.option.electricPumpTagged.de: Apply to fluids in the tag fluidcompat:managed_fluids.
fluidcompat.option.seawaterEnabled.desc: Make the Seawater Pump drain the water source below it.
World water consumed per unit of seawater made. 100 = one for one.
fluidcompat.option.seawaterMinTicks.desc: Minimum ticks between two drains of the same pump. 0 = no limit.
fluidcompat.option.seawaterShortfall.des: SCALE_DOWN produces less seawater, STOP produces none for that cycle.
fluidcompat.option.seawaterDrainThinWate: Let the Seawater Pump keep working when the water below it is a thin Flowing Fluids layer instead of a full source block. Without it the pump stops after a cycle or two, because each cycle takes its water from that same cell. Output is unchanged and always paid by the world.
fluidcompat.option.fluidloggedEnabled.de: Register the Fluid Compat addon in Fluidlogged. Needs a restart.
fluidcompat.option.fluidloggedFluidlogga: Pipes can contain fluid, so flowing water no longer destroys them.
Fluid passes through pipes instead of treating them as walls.
fluidcompat.option.fluidloggedShapeIndep: Let fluid pass whatever the pipe shape is.
fluidcompat.option.fluidloggedBlockClass: Java class names of pipe-like blocks. Every block of these classes is covered.
fluidcompat.option.fluidloggedExtraBlock: Block ids like modid:block or block tags like #modid:tag to include as well.
fluidcompat.option.logFileEnabled.desc: Write logs/fluidcompat.log in the game folder.
fluidcompat.option.logVerbose.desc: Also log every fluid intake. Turn on for bug reports, off for normal play.
fluidcompat.option.logThrottle.desc: Minimum milliseconds between two verbose lines about the same machine.
jei.fluidcompat.compat_finite_pump: With Fluid Compat this pump no longer creates fluid from nothing. Everything it pumps is removed from the source blocks it takes from, so a small pond can run dry.
fluidcompat.notice.unofficial: An unofficial intermediary compatibility mod that helps Flowing Fluids (by Traben, LGPL) understand other mods better. Flowing Fluids is required.
fluidcompat.group.flowing_fluids_pipes.d: Teaches Flowing Fluids that pipes stay submerged instead of being drained and flickering. Uses the same pipe list as Fluidlogged.
fluidcompat.option.ffPipesEnabled.desc: Turn the whole pipe handling for Flowing Fluids on or off.
Registers pipes in Flowing Fluids as blocks that do not displace fluid, through its public API.
fluidcompat.option.ffPipesWaterlogMode.d: GLOBAL Flowing Fluids setting, also affects slabs and stairs. IGNORE (safe, default): pipes neither take nor give water, so they cannot duplicate it. KEEP_FLOWING_FLUIDS_SETTING changes nothing. Other modes are experimental and need the option below. Applied in memory when a world starts.
fluidcompat.option.logDebug.desc: Logs a full config dump, every loaded mod, every fluid intake without throttling and every pipe block update. Files get big, use it only for bug reports. Pipe tracing needs a restart.
fluidcompat.option.ffPipesAllowExperimen: Lets the mode above use values other than IGNORE / KEEP. Water duplication through pipes was observed with them. Testing only.
fluidcompat.option.ffPipesCleanOrphan.de: Removes water left in a waterlogged pipe once no non-pipe neighbour holds water. Stops hanging water cubes and stuck water.
fluidcompat.option.ffPipesCleanupInterva: Ticks between cleanup passes. Higher = less lag, slower cleanup.
Only pipes within this many chunks of a player are cleaned. Lower = less lag.
Small repairs for bugs inside Flowing Fluids itself, applied while the game starts. Each one switches itself off if Flowing Fluids fixes that code.
fluidcompat.option.ffPatchesDisabled.des: Turns the Flowing Fluids bug-fix patches off. Needs a game restart to take effect.
fluidcompat.option.ffFastInteractionChec: Skips NeoForge's fluid interaction check (lava meets water and similar) when a liquid block only changed its level. Saves a lot of server time with Flowing Fluids. Reactions between different fluids are still checked in full. Needs a game restart.
fluidcompat.option.fluidloggedRisk.desc: Fluidlogged keeps a hidden copy of the fluid inside pipes. With Flowing Fluids this was seen to duplicate water, so the addon is only registered when this is on. Keep it off. Needs a restart.
fluidcompat.group.pneumaticcraft.desc: Liquid Hopper and Gas Lift stop duplicating water, and the Liquid Hopper can also drain the thin leftover water of a pond.
fluidcompat.option.pncPickupEnabled.desc: Switch off PneumaticCraft's infinite water rule for pickups while water is finite.
fluidcompat.pnc.hopper_pull.on: Fluid Compat: this hopper also drains leftover water. Click to turn off.
fluidcompat.pnc.hopper_pull.off: Fluid Compat: leftover water drain is off for this hopper. Click to turn on.
fluidcompat.option.pncLeftoverWater.desc: Liquid Hopper also drains the thin leftover water of a pond that PneumaticCraft cannot pick up. Needs Flowing Fluids. Each hopper has its own button in its screen.
fluidcompat.option.pncLeftoverWithoutUpg: Lets the hopper drain leftover water without a Dispenser Upgrade. Off by default so it cannot be used as a shortcut: with the upgrade it also takes whole source blocks.
fluidcompat.option.pncNeedsOutput.desc: Only drain leftover water while the hopper's output side has a container that accepts water. Off: the hopper's own tank simply fills up.
fluidcompat.option.miDrainThinWater.desc: Let Modern Industrialization water pumps also pump the thin non-source water Flowing Fluids leaves behind, so a pond can be drained completely. Output per pump tier is unchanged and always paid by the world.
fluidcompat.option.pncEmptyRetry.desc: After finding no water a hopper waits this long before looking again. Higher = less work.
fluidcompat.option.pncGuiButton.desc: Shows the Fluid Compat on/off button in the Liquid Hopper screen (client setting).
fluidcompat.group.create.desc: Flowing Fluids supports Create by itself. Fluid Compat adds no Create hooks: it checks the combination at startup and keeps its pipe features away from Create's blocks.
fluidcompat.option.createEnabled.desc: Writes a startup report about Create + Flowing Fluids to logs/fluidcompat.log and warns about settings that contradict finite water. Changes nothing in the game.
fluidcompat.option.createExclude.desc: Fluid Compat's pipe features (non-displacers, pipe cleanup) skip Create's blocks so nothing overlaps with Flowing Fluids' own Create support.
fluidcompat.group.auto_balanced.desc: When the server lags, Fluid Compat stretches the intervals of its own optional housekeeping instead of adding load. It never delays the finite-water logic and never changes Flowing Fluids or Create settings.
fluidcompat.option.autoBalancedEnabled.d: Turn the automatic slowdown of Fluid Compat's optional work on or off.
Use Flowing Fluids' own tick-time target while its auto performance is not OFF, so both mods agree on when the server is slow.
fluidcompat.option.autoBalancedTarget.de: Average tick time above which Fluid Compat backs off (used when it does not follow Flowing Fluids).
fluidcompat.option.autoBalancedMaxSlowdo: Largest factor optional intervals are multiplied by while the server is slow. 1 = never slow down.
